id.description: Unique identifier for the fate thread

user_id.description: ID of the user this thread belongs to

fate_type.description: Type of fate thread (Clotho's, Lachesis's, or Atropos's)

primary_aspect.description: Primary aspect of the user's fate

secondary_aspect.description: Secondary aspect of the user's fate

description.description: Mystical description of the fate thread

thread_strength.description: Strength of the thread based on account age and activity

thread_color.description: Color of the thread in CSS format

prophecy.description: An AI-generated prophecy about the user's future trajectory

database.instructions: This database stores mystical fate threads generated from user metadata. Each thread represents a user's destiny as woven by the three Moirai (Fates) from Greek mythology. Threads are categorized by fate type based on account age, and contain mystical descriptions generated from username characteristics and other metadata. Prophecies can be generated to predict future events based on a user's trajectory.
